name: University Student

intro.text: I'm studying for exams and learning Turkish at an evening class. My grandmother says her mother spoke it at the market in the old days. Help me procrastinate?

win: Teşekkürler. That's 'thanks' in Turkish. See? Evening class works.
after: Most people my age have never known the island in one piece. We cross for coffee, for concerts, for friends. It's not politics. It's Thursday.
